abstract: BACKGROUND: Cisplatin cures over 80% of testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs), and nucleotide-excision repair (NER) modifies the sensitivity to cisplatin. We explored the association between NER proteins and their polymorphisms with cisplatin sensitivity (CPS) and overall survival (OS) of patients with non-seminomatous (ns)-TGCTs. METHODS: The expression of ERCC1 and XPA and the presence of γH2AX were evaluated in cancer cell lines and in fresh ns-TGCTs. The ERCC1 protein was also determined in ns-TGCTs. The differences between CPS and non-CPS cell lines and patients were analysed by Student's t- or χ(2)-tests. The differences in OS were analysed using the log-rank test, and the hazard ratios (HRs) were calculated using the Cox model. RESULTS: High ERCC1 expression was observed in the non-CPS cells, and both ERCC1 and γH2AX expressions were augmented after cisplatin treatment. Increased ERCC1 expression was also identified in non-CPS patients. Neither polymorphism was associated with either CPS or OS. The presence of ERCC1 was associated with non-CPS (P=0.05) and adjusted in the prognosis groups. The HR in ERCC1-negative and non-CPS patients was >14.43, and in ERCC1-positive and non-CPS patients the HR was >11.86 (P<0.001). CONCLUSIONS: High levels of ERCC1 were associated with non-CPS, suggesting that ERCC1 could be used as a potential indicator of the response to cisplatin and prognosis in ns-TGCTs.
abstract_ja: 背景：シスプラチンは精巣胚細胞腫瘍（TGCT）の80%以上を治癒させるが、ヌクレオチド除去修復（NER）はシスプラチンに対する感受性を変化させる。我々は、非セミノーマ性TGCT（ns-TGCT）患者において、NERタンパク質とその多型がシスプラチン感受性（CPS）および全生存期間（OS）とどのように関連するかを検討した。方法：癌細胞株および新鮮なns-TGCTにおけるERCC1とXPAの発現、ならびにγH2AXの有無を評価した。ns-TGCTにおけるERCC1タンパク質も測定した。CPS細胞株と非CPS細胞株、およびCPS患者と非CPS患者の差は、Student's t検定またはχ二乗検定で解析した。OSの差はlog-rank検定で解析し、ハザード比（HR）はCox比例ハザードモデルで算出した。結果：非CPS細胞ではERCC1の高発現がみられ、シスプラチン処理後にはERCC1とγH2AXの発現がいずれも増強した。非CPS患者でもERCC1の発現増加が認められた。いずれの多型もCPSやOSとは関連しなかった。ERCC1の存在は非CPSと関連しており（P=0.05）、予後分類で調整された。ERCC1陰性かつ非CPSの患者のHRは14.43超、ERCC1陽性かつ非CPSの患者のHRは11.86超であった（P<0.001）。結論：ERCC1の高レベルは非CPSと関連しており、ERCC1がns-TGCTにおけるシスプラチン反応性と予後の指標として有用である可能性が示唆される。
